rule: nodes 1-10 (the real KSPCB station streams) are always water_quality; the remaining water slots and all other categories are drawn without replacement from nodes 11-200 with the assignment seed
how_to_read: for node k take the rows of source_dataset with node_id == k (same node id, same position, same round). Each node keeps its own profile fields; all nodes use the same routing configuration; no relay-only nodes.
